title: Decision Path Playground: Console tool for region / tier selection and fallback model variants
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a Console-first interactive 'Decision Path Playground' that lets customers author, validate, preview, and simulate routing policies combining region selection, tier routing (e.g. standard/premium), and fallback model variants. The Playground is intended to be the canonical authoring surface for complex policies: visual rule builder + textual DSL view + deterministic simulator that replays synthetic or sampled traffic to surface cost/latency/quality tradeoffs and policy safety warnings.
acceptance_criteria: Authoring: Users can create a multi-step policy that specifies region preference, tier ordering, and fallback model variants via a drag/drop visual canvas and a synchronized DSL editor.
Validation: The UI runs a static validation pass that flags unreachable rules, conflicting tiers, and model-incompatibility (e.g., model variant doesn't support function-calls).

Preview/Simulation: Users can run a preview that replays a configurable set of test inputs (synthetic or linked from a saved prompt set) and shows per-request route, latency estimate, cost estimate, and quality delta compared to baseline.
Rollout Hooks: The composer exposes canary percentage and automatic fallback policies and emits a JSON policy that the control plane can consume for a canary rollout.
Telemetry: Actions (save, simulate, publish) are instrumented and visible in Console analytics; simulation results persist to a temporary run ID.
Docs & Help: Contextual help panels accessible in the composer and a link to the policy DSL reference doc.
Security: Preview mode sanitizes any customer prompt data; no secrets are exposed in simulation logs.
technical_notes: Validation engine will reuse runtime compatibility matrix from model catalog (eng:ENG-40110). Simulation backend will call the sandboxed simulator service (eng:ENG-42788) with capped token budget and deterministic pseudo-rng to ensure reproducible samples. Cost estimates use the current pricing model; latency estimates derive from per-model per-region median p95 from telemetry plus additive penalties for cold-starts and cross-region egress. UI will store drafts in Console config store and generate a policy JSON spec compatible with routing-api v2. Support for policy imports (yaml/json) is required.
